import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SUBJECT = "code/rust/src/category_theory/functor/full_functor.rs"
WORK = ROOT / ".venv-review/full-functor-audit-v2"
OUT = ROOT / "evidence/quality/full_functor_validation"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
snapshot = WORK / "src/category_theory"
if snapshot.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("Refusing to overwrite an existing source snapshot")
shutil.copytree(ROOT / "code/rust/src/category_theory", snapshot,
                ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("*.contract.score.yaml", "target"))
manifest = '''[workspace]
members = ["."]
resolver = "2"
[package]
name = "tfqm_functor_shell_audit"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
[lib]
name = "tfqm_category_theory"
path = "src/category_theory/lib.rs"
[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
num-rational = "0.4"
num-traits = "0.2"
[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0"
[profile.dev]
debug = 0
[profile.test]
debug = 0
'''
(WORK / "Cargo.toml").write_text(manifest, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
tests = 'use tfqm_category_theory::errors::ArithmosError;\nuse tfqm_category_theory::functor::full_functor::{\n    FullFunctor, FullnessWitness, LabeledMorphism,\n};\n\nfn populated() -> FullFunctor {\n    let image = LabeledMorphism::new("Fa", "Fb", "g");\n    FullFunctor::on_functor("full", "F")\n        .with_obligation(image.clone())\n        .with_witness(FullnessWitness::new(LabeledMorphism::new("a", "b", "f"), image))\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn legacy_serialized_record_is_explicitly_vacuous() {\n    let value: FullFunctor = serde_json::from_str(\n        r#"{"label":"full","functor_ref":"F","notes":[]}"#\n    ).unwrap();\n    assert!(value.is_vacuous());\n    assert!(value.validated().is_ok());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn populated_record_roundtrips_without_changing_witnesses() {\n    let value = populated().with_note("");\n    let raw: FullFunctor = serde_json::from_str(&serde_json::to_string(&value).unwrap()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(raw.validated().unwrap(), value);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn deserialized_uncovered_obligation_is_refused_by_owned_admission() {\n    let mut value = serde_json::to_value(populated()).unwrap();\n    value["witnesses"] = serde_json::json!([]);\n    let raw: FullFunctor = serde_json::from_value(value).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(raw.validated(), Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape(\n        "obligation g : Fa -> Fb has no witness".into()\n    )));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn deserialized_blank_label_is_refused_by_owned_admission() {\n    let mut value = serde_json::to_value(populated()).unwrap();\n    value["label"] = serde_json::json!(" \\t");\n    let raw: FullFunctor = serde_json::from_value(value).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(raw.validated(), Err(ArithmosError::InvalidShape("empty label".into())));\n}\n'

(WORK / "tests").mkdir()
(WORK / "tests/serde_boundary.rs").write_text(tests, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

before = (ROOT / SUBJECT).read_bytes()
source_snapshot = {
    p.relative_to(snapshot).as_posix(): sha(p.read_bytes())
    for p in sorted(snapshot.rglob("*.rs"))
}
record = {
    "AuthorityEffect": "None",
    "source": SUBJECT,
    "source_sha256": sha(before),
    "source_lf_only": b"\r" not in before,
    "base": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
    "scope": "Actual complete category-library Rust source snapshot, compiled via an isolated manifest; original build.rs governance hook and optional external workspace packages are not executed.",
    "source_snapshot": source_snapshot,
    "harness_manifest": manifest,
    "serde_boundary_tests": tests,
    "tools": {},
    "steps": [],
    "mutations": [],
}
for name in ["cargo", "rustc"]:
    record["tools"][name] = subprocess.check_output([name, "--version"], text=True).strip()

def run(argv, log_name):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8")
    text = result.stdout + result.stderr
    (OUT / log_name).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    step = {"argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode,
            "log": (OUT / log_name).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "log_sha256": sha((OUT / log_name).read_bytes())}
    print(log_name, "exit", result.returncode, flush=True)
    print(text[-2200:], flush=True)
    return step

base = ["cargo", "test", "--offline", "--locked", "--manifest-path", str(WORK / "Cargo.toml")]
lock = run(["cargo", "generate-lockfile", "--offline", "--manifest-path", str(WORK / "Cargo.toml")], "lock.log")
record["steps"].append(lock)
if lock["exit_code"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Offline dependency resolution failed")
baseline = run(base, "category-tests.log")
record["steps"].append(baseline)
if baseline["exit_code"]:
    (OUT / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    raise RuntimeError("Baseline tests failed")

target = snapshot / "functor/full_functor.rs"
original = target.read_bytes()
production = original.decode("utf-8")
cases = [('label', 'if self.label.trim().is_empty() {', 'if false {', 'labels_are_checked_independently'), ('reference', 'if self.functor_ref.trim().is_empty() {', 'if false {', 'labels_are_checked_independently'), ('coverage', 'if !covered.contains(ob) {', 'if false && !covered.contains(ob) {', 'every_declared_obligation_needs_a_witness'), ('dangling', 'if !obligations.contains(&w.image) {', 'if false && !obligations.contains(&w.image) {', 'dangling_images_are_rejected_including_wrong_endpoints'), ('source-endpoints', 'check_endpoints(&mut endpoints, &w.preimage, "source")?;', 'if false { check_endpoints(&mut endpoints, &w.preimage, "source")?; }', 'source_arrow_labels_have_consistent_endpoints'), ('functionality', 'if previous != &w.image {', 'if false && previous != &w.image {', 'one_source_arrow_cannot_claim_two_images'), ('map-duplicates', 'if index.insert(source.as_str(), target.as_str()).is_some() {', 'if index.insert(source.as_str(), target.as_str()).is_some() && false {', 'malformed_maps_are_rejected_even_for_a_vacuous_claim'), ('map-value', 'if actual != expected {', 'if false && actual != expected {', 'each_witness_map_value_must_agree'), ('distinct-preimages', '.filter(|(_, preimages)| preimages.len() > 1)', '.filter(|(_, preimages)| !preimages.is_empty())', 'repeated_identical_witnesses_are_not_distinct_preimages'), ('empty-maps', 'let objects = map_index(object_map, "object_map")?;', 'if object_map.is_empty() || morphism_map.is_empty() { return Ok(()); }\n        let objects = map_index(object_map, "object_map")?;', 'empty_maps_are_not_unspecified_maps'), ('obligation-duplicates', 'if !obligations.insert(ob) {', 'if !obligations.insert(ob) && false {', 'identical_obligations_are_rejected'), ('target-endpoints', 'if previous != pair {', 'if false && previous != pair {', 'target_arrow_labels_have_consistent_endpoints')]

try:
    for name, needle, replacement, test in cases:
        if production.count(needle) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Mutation anchor is not unique: " + name)
        target.write_text(production.replace(needle, replacement), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        step = run(base + ["--lib", "functor::full_functor::tests::" + test, "--", "--exact"],
                   "mutant-" + name + ".log")
        text = (ROOT / step["log"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        killed = step["exit_code"] == 101 and "1 failed" in text and "could not compile" not in text
        record["mutations"].append({"id": name, "outcome": "killed" if killed else "unexpected",
                                     "test": test, "needle": needle, "replacement": replacement, **step})
        if not killed:
            raise RuntimeError("Expected an assertion failure from mutant " + name)
finally:
    target.write_bytes(original)
    record["snapshot_subject_restored"] = target.read_bytes() == original
    record["working_source_unchanged"] = (ROOT / SUBJECT).read_bytes() == before
    record["dependency_lockfile"] = (WORK / "Cargo.lock").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    record["dependency_lockfile_sha256"] = sha((WORK / "Cargo.lock").read_bytes())
    record["limits"] = [
        "Twelve selected guard mutations only; no exhaustive mutation coverage or performance claim.",
        "Raw Deserialize and public fields remain unchecked/mutable; validated() checks only the current shell.",
        "No category, functor-law, theorem, DAG-status or authority promotion."
    ]
    (OUT / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print("Audit complete: full category library and serde boundary passed; twelve guard mutants killed.", flush=True)

source_review.manual_structure: Factored obligation, witness, endpoint and raw-map checks; ordered borrowed indexes and deduplicated diagnostics; no recursion or unsafe. No calibrated compiler-expanded metrics or allocation-failure bound claimed.

historical_attempt.note: Retained separately; the corrected twelve-case run is not a percentage over this earlier failed attempt.

scope_counterexample.construction: Discrete C on a,b with identities ia,ib; terminal D on X with identity e; F maps both objects to X and both identities to e.
scope_counterexample.admission: Existing ValidatedFiniteCategory and ValidatedFiniteFunctor constructors accept the declared finite data.
scope_counterexample.observations: Supplied-list checks pass with obligation e and witnesses ia,ib. Per-source-Hom maps are injective, yet two cross-object pairs have no lift of e. Neither actual fullness nor nonfaithfulness follows from these record checks.
